rules.statement: A mortgage executed while the registration of a seizure is in force, is void as against the Fiscal's transferee if such mortgage is merely a renewal in whole or in part and not in excess of a mortgage existing prior to registration.
rules.supporting_quote: "The provisions of section 238 do not, in my opinion, operate to give a purchaser a title free of a mortgage executed while the registration of a seizure is in force, if such mortgage is merely a renewal, in whole or in part and not in excess, of a mortgage existing prior to the registration."
